review_notes: I read the whole file (lines 1–91). It has four definitions: stepTicks, stepCoefficient, stepBudget and originalStepCoefficient. Each is project-specific. stepTicks sums the pivot-decision and descent tick counts of a Turing-machine-style simulation. The other three are polynomial budget constants and a budget function, built from the project's own descentCoefficient. None of them corresponds to a concept in Mathlib, Batteries or Lean core. stepBudget is a monomial with a constant coefficient, and Mathlib has no named abstraction for it that would replace it. The theorems are bounds on these project quantities, so they fall under the excluded category of standalone theorem duplication and proof shortening. I did not open the upstream project modules, so I did not check whether they define a competing notion. I found no justified finding under this rubric.
